title: Blourish & Flotts: Beautifully Retold
author: Blourish and Flotts
description: Welcome to Blourish & Flotts, where beloved fanfiction is beautifully retold. Each video transforms a chapter into classically inspired prose, paired with original illustrations and an elegant ebook-style read-along experience. Once the chapter ends, the conversation begins with a thoughtful discussion of the characters, themes, relationships, choices, and moments that made the story memorable. This channel is for readers who love immersive storytelling, literary atmosphere, and having someone to talk with about what they're reading. Come for the story. Stay for the company.
